name: heterogeneous_routed_final_protocol_v1
round_scope: This protocol freezes the one-round comparison currently implemented. A separate protocol is required before any multi-round claim.

client_data.partition: disjoint, 256 target-task source examples per client, 64 per AG News class before mixture

router.name: relative_balanced_rank
router.gate: client q25 class-conditional anchor gradient cosine divided by anchor-reference q25
router.selection: equal quota by claimed target label using mean percentile ranks of negative gradient cosine, loss, and canonical-label inconsistency
router.off_task_action_when_triggered: no target-label quota; excluded from selected target-task set

evaluation.final: official AG News test split, never used in routing or hyperparameter selection
evaluation.statistics: paired seed comparisons, 95% confidence intervals, Holm correction over primary method comparisons

claim_gate: Routed distillation must beat public-anchor-only under matched client/server steps and communication accounting, preserve the clean setting within 2 percentage points, and reproduce across all final seeds before an algorithmic claim.
